All CPSE purchases from MSMEs are to be settled on TReDS, with CGTMSE guarantees for TReDS discounting
TReDS will be merged with the MSME Samadhaan portal
Only private corporates will be allowed to use TReDS
x: Budget 2026-27 mandated settlement of all CPSE purchases from MSMEs on TReDS, CGTMSE guarantees for TReDS discounting, a GeM-TReDS link and receivables as asset-backed securities. TReDS platforms remain RBI-regulated, are not merged with Samadhaan (a delayed-payment portal), and serve government and PSU buyers as well as corporates.

s: Under PMMY (MUDRA), up to what amount are collateral-free loans available?
x: MUDRA gives collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh under Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus.

s: ECLGS 5.0 (May 2026) gives a 100% guarantee to units hit by which of the following?
x: ECLGS 5.0 (May 2026) offers 100% guarantee for units hit by the West Asia crisis; ECLGS itself began in 2020.

x: CGTMSE gives collateral-free guarantees; its corpus ratio is Government : SIDBI = 4:1, not 1:4.

s: Which of the following is NOT a loan category under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana?
x: MUDRA loans are given as Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus; there is no Vriddhi category.

o: Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency
Micro Units Development and Regulatory Authority
Medium Units Development and Refinance Agency
Micro Undertakings Delivery and Refinance Agency

s: In which year did the TReDS platforms for discounting MSME invoices start?
x: TReDS, the RBI-regulated online invoice discounting system (RXIL, M1xchange, Invoicemart), started in 2017.

s: MUDRA was set up as a wholly owned subsidiary of which institution?
x: MUDRA was set up in 2015 as a wholly owned subsidiary of SIDBI to refinance loans to micro units.

s: When was the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana launched?
x: PMMY and MUDRA were launched by the Prime Minister on 8 April 2015.

o: A KVIC subsidy programme for traditional artisans launched in 2008
A World Bank credit programme for CPSEs launched in 2020
A SIDBI entrepreneurship-awareness campaign launched in 2021 in aspirational districts
A GeM procurement platform launched in 2016
x: Udyam Abhilasha is a SIDBI entrepreneurship-awareness campaign of 2021 aimed at aspirational districts.

s: Which one of the following is a feature of Udyam Registration?
o: It is operated only for enterprises receiving PMEGP subsidy.
It is restricted to large manufacturing companies.
It is a paid, paper-based registration requiring physical verification in every case.
It is a free, paperless, self-declaration portal linked with GeM, income tax, GST and TReDS.
x: Udyam Registration, introduced in 2020, is free, paperless and based on self-declaration; it is linked with GeM, income tax, GST and TReDS.

s: In the case of a non-individual enterprise under Stand-Up India, eligibility requires that at least what shareholding and control be with SC/ST persons or women?
x: A non-individual enterprise qualifies when at least 51 per cent of its shareholding and control is held by SC/ST persons or women.

s: Stand-Up India, launched in April 2016, supports which kind of enterprise?
x: Stand-Up India supports only greenfield (new) enterprises promoted by SC/ST persons or women. It is not a rehabilitation scheme for sick units, does not fund expansion of existing units, and has nothing to do with disinvestment of PSEs.

x: PMEGP, a credit-linked margin-money subsidy scheme for new micro-enterprises, is implemented by KVIC, not NABARD.

x: PMEGP came in 2008, a year after the Ministry of MSME (2007); Stand-Up India followed in 2016 and Udyam Registration in 2020.
